label: Medieval fantasy
blurb: A fantasy village: smiths, innkeepers, guards, healers and the odd elf.

elf.label: Elf
elf.features: long pointed ears and delicate features

half_elf.label: Half-elf
half_elf.features: slightly pointed ears and fine features

dwarf.label: Dwarf
dwarf.features: a broad sturdy frame and a stout stature

halfling.label: Halfling
halfling.features: a small stature and rosy cheeks

gnome.label: Gnome
gnome.features: a small stature, a large nose and bright curious eyes

half_orc.label: Half-orc
half_orc.features: small lower tusks and a heavy brow

orc.label: Orc
orc.features: prominent lower tusks, a heavy brow and a powerful frame

tiefling.label: Tiefling
tiefling.features: small curved horns and unusually bright eyes

hobbies: telling tall tales at the tavern
carving wooden toys for the children
practising sword forms behind the barn
collecting shiny pebbles from the stream
telling ghost stories by the fire
quirks: never trusting anyone who won't share a drink
sniffing every coin before accepting it
always knocking twice before opening a door
leaving a saucer of milk out for the house spirit
talking to every cat in the village
refusing to cross running water at night
never sitting with {poss} back to a window
goals: building a house by the river
forging a blade worthy of a hero
hunting the wolf that took {poss} flock
accessories: a feather tucked in the hair
a leather satchel across the chest
a belt of small leather pouches
a small dagger at the belt
a pilgrim's badge on the collar
a lantern hanging from the belt
a silver holy symbol on a chain
default_outfits: a homespun tunic, patched trousers and worn leather boots

default_outfits.t: a simple wool dress with a laced bodice, an apron and leather shoes

default_outfits: a hooded traveling cloak over a linen shirt, brown trousers and boots
_tables: The next entries replace the shared tables in common.json for this setting only (same shape): no undercuts, dye or modern eyewear in a medieval village.

hair_styles.label: long hair tied back with a leather cord
hair pinned up under a cap
hair with small braids woven in

distinguishing.label: a faded scar across the cheek
a tattoo of a knotwork band on the forearm
a small scar through one eyebrow
a braided lock with a bead in it
a small mole on the cheek
